name: Evolution, Ecology and Organismal Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; 2027 entry dates not explicitly confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Autumn application
publishedDeadlines.note: Recurring date without stated entry year.

english.note: Official scores within two years sent by application deadline; if received valid, expiry before entry does not invalidate admission proof. No MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Citizenship/degree from listed countries or US permanent-resident/asylee/refugee status over one year may exempt; overseas English-medium instruction alone does not. Higher program minima control; TA and writing assessments separate.

applicationFee.note: International 70 USD; US 60 USD. Conditional recruitment-code or preapproved departmental payment routes; international eligibility should be confirmed. Economic-disadvantage, FreeApp and SROP categories exclude international applicants. Waiver approved or fee paid before admission; one per year and no refund after payment.

documents: Official transcripts; student-issued copies can go to department temporarily while official records pending
Statement of purpose and research interests
requirements.note: Bachelor’s required, master’s unnecessary. Biology, chemistry, physics, calculus and statistics recommended. Name intended faculty; prior advisor approval required, no admission without designated advisor.

funding.note: Most students funded via 20-hour/week TA/RA or university fellowship; undated approximate monthly rate 2,897 USD plus full tuition waiver and employer-supported benefits. No all-admitted guarantee or explicit international coverage established.
